name: tempo-cli
description: Run Tempo weekly recaps and coaching tools from Claude Desktop against your self-hosted Tempo instance.
long_description:
Connects Claude Desktop to your self-hosted Tempo running tracker via the local tempo-cli MCP server. Generate weekly recap markdown reports, collect subjective interview answers as YAML, and save prescribed weekly plans — without copy-pasting from a terminal.

Uses the same configuration as the tempo CLI (`config.toml` and `TEMPO_*` environment variables). Leave the install dialog fields blank if you already have a config file.

base_url.title: Tempo base URL
base_url.description: Your Tempo instance URL (e.g. http://localhost:5001 or https://tempo.example.com). Leave blank to use config.toml or TEMPO_BASE_URL.

api_key.title: Tempo API key
api_key.description: API key issued in Tempo (tmp_…). Stored in the OS keychain. Leave blank to use config.toml or TEMPO_API_KEY.

tools.name: check_connection
tools.description: Probe Tempo health and API-key auth.

tools.name: generate_weekly_recap
tools.description: Generate the weekly recap markdown report (or needs_subjective questionnaire).

tools.name: save_prescribed_week
tools.description: Write prescribed-{week}.yaml for next week's plan.
